purpose: Prevent tuning to the final observational interval if a future source-environment model comparison uses these data; not required by the Stage-2 direct-transport test.

development.role: adapter development and any permitted model configuration work

ams02_2025.selection_rule: First 80 percent of the 147 published rotations for development; final 20 percent held out. Missing published rotations remain missing and are never interpolated.
ams02_2025.activation_gate: Before activation, the future environment model must declare compatible epochs, inputs, species definitions, location, exclusions, metrics, and acceptance thresholds. If incompatible, revise this record under a new schema revision before inspecting holdout residuals.

ace_cris.reason: A defensible ACE calibration/holdout interval requires a declared comparison objective and a documented exclusion policy for SEP-contaminated or instrument-flagged days.
